Repair any actual gap within your own report. Do not stop with only this technical audit.

The prime-n complete-quadrangle Kummer covers have H²=5n³, Delta=n³(n²-10), K numerically (n-2)H. n=7 satisfies Delta>6H². I28 requires gr_F R exactly the full section ring T(X,H), F1=m, complete multiplicative cofinal separated filtration. Its weighted hypersurface mechanism example has Delta below threshold and is not a target realization. Higher-order perturbations can change the FULL initial ideal by syzygies (twisted cubic example). Veronese q must satisfy n²-10>30q²; no unspecified large-Veronese repair.

Develop at least two genuine construction approaches, e.g. (1) positive-weight deformation classes of the actual section ring via T^1/normal sequences/eigensheaf cohomology for this Kummer cover, with syzygy compatibility and all-order integration; (2) a formal neighborhood/finite cover/branch construction giving a negative Cartier divisor with the exact required conormal and algebraizable contraction, and a computable invariant proving the completed local ring is not merely the cone. These are suggestions, choose better if justified. Track graded sign conventions and distinguish deforming the polarized surface (still a cone) from deforming its formal neighborhood/cone germ. A nonzero first-order class alone neither proves all-order existence nor nonisomorphism of a specified nonzero completed fiber. Neither is a supplied regular finite model by itself a substantial theorem.

Use strongest actual source machinery and current primary prior art, especially Pinkham/Wahl cone deformations/formal neighborhoods and I28's Anghel/Chen/Chen-Sun comparisons. Avoid unrelated Ulam/tensor routes and parked Saxl/unimodality.
